headline: Innio And 2 Other AI Infrastructure Stocks To Own
summary: Blackstone’s decision to pour capital into data centers and power infrastructure signals how quickly AI is moving from hype to hardware. The real money is shifting into the pipes, concrete, and electrons that keep neural networks running. That creates a window for investors who focus on the physical backbone of AI instead of headline software stories.
